children: Independence Realty Trust entered into an amendment to its merger agreement with Centerspace to implement an alternative structure for the company-level merger. Under the change, Centerspace will merge into IRT Merger Sub, with IRT Merger Sub surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Independence Realty Trust. The parties also agreed to waive any representation inaccuracies caused solely by this structural change. The amendment is intended to streamline execution ahead of filing the joint proxy statement/prospectus on Form S-4.
: Amendment to Agreement and Plan of Merger
: Implement alternative merger structure for efficiency
